#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 100000000;

struct Node {
    Node *left, *right;
    int minVal;
    bool dirty;
    int batchValue;

    Node() : left(nullptr), right(nullptr), minVal(INF), dirty(false), batchValue(0) {}

    static void setRange(int f, int t, int l, int r, int v, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return;
        if (f <= l && t >= r) {
            node->setVal(v);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        setRange(f, t, l, m, v, node->left);
        setRange(f, t, m + 1, r, v, node->right);
        node->update();
    }

    static Node* create(int l, int r) {
        Node* node = new Node();
        if (l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            node->left = create(l, m);
            node->right = create(m + 1, r);
        }
        node->minVal = INF;
        return node;
    }

    static int queryRange(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) return node->minVal;
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return min(queryRange(f, t, l, m, node->left), queryRange(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
    }

    static void fillFromArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            node->minVal = data[l];
            return;
        }
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fillFromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fillFromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
        node->update();
    }

    static void fillToArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = node->minVal;
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fillToArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fillToArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    }

    void update() {
        this->minVal = min(left->minVal, right->minVal);
    }

    void setVal(int v) {
        this->minVal = v;
        this->batchValue = v;
        this->dirty = true;
    }

    void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            left->setVal(batchValue);
            right->setVal(batchValue);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> intervals[i][0] >> intervals[i][1];
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    k++;
    Node* dpStates[2];
    dpStates[0] = Node::create(0, n);
    dpStates[1] = Node::create(0, n);

    int* tempBuffer = new int[n + 1];

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        Node* currentDP = dpStates[i & 1];
        Node* previousDP = dpStates[(i - 1) & 1];

        int* interval = &intervals[i][0];
        int intervalSize = interval[1] - interval[0];
        int middleSize = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        Node::fillToArray(0, n, tempBuffer, previousDP);
        int copyStart = 0;
        int copyEnd = min(n, intervalSize + middleSize);
        int copyLength = copyEnd - copyStart;
        if (copyLength > 0) {
            std::memcpy(tempBuffer + copyStart, tempBuffer, copyLength * sizeof(int));
        }
        std::fill(tempBuffer, tempBuffer + copyEnd, INF);

        int minX = interval[1] - middleSize - intervalSize;
        int maxX = interval[1] - middleSize;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int needTime = Node::queryRange(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, previousDP);
            tempBuffer[j] = min(tempBuffer[j], needTime + 1);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int needTime = Node::queryRange(j - middleSize - intervalSize, j - middleSize, 0, n, previousDP);
            tempBuffer[j] = min(tempBuffer[j], needTime + 2);
        }

        Node::fillFromArray(0, n, tempBuffer, currentDP);
    }

    int minTime = Node::queryRange(n, n, 0, n, dpStates[k & 1]);
    if (minTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full\n" << minTime << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    }

    delete[] tempBuffer;
    return 0;
}
